summary: Iteration 4 — tested 4 new features (custom date range, multi-admin users, branding, weekly digest + cron). 18/18 backend pytest cases pass. End-to-end Playwright flows all pass: super admin login + sidebar, dashboard rentang-tanggal, user create/delete via modal, seed admin un-deletable, branding form with all testids + send-digest-now, RBAC blocks regular admin from users/branding nav and redirects direct URL. Previous iteration-3 regression suite kept intact.

ui_bugs.issue: Login email/password/submit inputs lack data-testid (login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button not found). Not blocking but inconsistent with rest of the app.

'Simpan' submit button has no type='submit' and no data-testid; the Nama <input> has no name attribute. Tests work only via positional index or button text. Add data-testid='save-user-button' and name='name' for robustness.

action_items: (Optional/Low) Add data-testid to AdminLogin inputs: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button.
(Optional/Low) Add data-testid='save-user-button' and name='name' to UserEditor fields; ensure Simpan button is type='submit'.
critical_code_review_comments: Cron webhook uses hmac.compare_digest for timing-safe bearer comparison and idempotency via X-Webhook-Id — correctly implemented.
run_weekly_digest is enqueued as a FastAPI BackgroundTask so the cron endpoint returns 2xx immediately as required.
Public GET /api/branding correctly excludes digest_recipient PII; MongoDB _id excluded everywhere.
BrandingIn validator enforces 6-digit HEX color and 300KB logo size — good input validation.
delete_user protects both the currently-logged-in account and the seeded ADMIN_EMAIL (super admin utama) — matches spec.
super_admin dependency is composed on top of current_admin — role check centralized and clean.
_assert_safe_email applies strong G2/G3 guardrails on outgoing email (no forms, https-only, no shorteners, same-site anchor text). Good.
Minor: UserIn.EmailStr uses the stricter email-validator deliverability check which rejects .local addresses — test files must use example.com (not a bug, just a note for test authors).
test_credentials: admin@survey.local / AdminSurvey2026! (super_admin). Test regular admins are created on the fly via POST /api/admin/users and cleaned up by the test fixture.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete short-lived regular admin accounts (test_regadmin_*@example.com, test_crud_*@example.com, ui_*@example.com). Branding is modified in test_branding_update_and_public_reflects and restored via finally-block. No lingering test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-4 features verified. Known-good test fixtures: use @example.com (NOT .local) for created users because EmailStr strict deliverability check rejects reserved TLDs. For digest-send-now use delivered@resend.dev (Resend test address) — other recipients will 422 from the proxy as EXPECTED behavior. WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET must be read from /app/backend/.env at test time (do not hardcode). The pytest.ini uses -n auto so tests run in parallel; fixtures are module-scoped and should still be safe.
rca of the issue: No issues. Initial test fixture used *@example.local which was rejected by EmailStr — fixed in test file by switching to example.com.
